Setting.Name: D724::TicketAudit::Enabled
Setting.Description: Requires immutable tenant binding and transaction-atomic audit for covered OTOBO ticket mutations.

Setting.Name: D724::TicketPolicy::Enabled
Setting.Description: Fail-closed tenant filtering for OTOBO ticket search and read adapters.

Setting.Name: D724::SearchPolicy::Enabled
Setting.Description: Requires a trusted tenant context and mandatory filter for every D724 Elasticsearch query.

Setting.Name: D724::SearchPolicy::TenantSafeIndexes
Setting.Description: Elasticsearch indexes whose documents and final query filter carry the D724 tenant discriminator.

Setting.Name: Ticket::CustomModule###724-D724TicketAudit
Setting.Description: Loads the D724 transaction and audit wrapper for OTOBO ticket repository mutations.
